channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee remains close to seven-week low on Wednesday, Fed's policy in focus
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) holds onto over-a-week long losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: Growth risks temper RBNZ pricing – ING
item.description: ING notes that New Zealand’s Q2 GDP slowdown could magnify market impact given infrequent data, but the Reserve Bank of New Zealand remains focused on inflation and jobs.

item.title: Gold rebounds as traders position for Fed interest rate decision
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) rebounds on Wednesday as sellers trim their exposure ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement.

item.title: Euro trades with caution against US Dollar ahead of Fed’s policy meeting
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades subduedly at around 1.1535 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The major currency pair trades cautiously ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Downside risk persists against US Dollar - UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD has pulled back after Monday’s sharper-than-expected drop, with intraday price action now seen confined to a 0.7100–0.7140 band.

item.title: Why is the US Dollar firm when the Federal Reserve hike is already fully priced in?
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) is trading with a firm undertone heading into the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) interest rate decision, supported by a relentless march higher in US Treasury yields that has pushed the 10-year yield to 5.00% and the 2-year yield to 4.66%.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD consolidates below $4,350 ahead of Fed decision
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades cautiously below $4,350 on Wednesday as investors refrain from taking large positions ahead of the Federal Reserve (Fed) monetary policy decision.

item.title: Euro: Firm Dollar keeps pressure on Euro before FOMC - Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that the US Dollar (USD) remained firm, pushing EUR/USD modestly lower as risk sentiment weakened. In the euro area, Germany’s September ZEW survey showed a sharp improvement in current conditions, while expectations disappointed.

item.title: British Pound: 1.3440–1.3420 support in focus against US Dollar - Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale highlights GBP/USD trading just above its 200-day moving average, with the August trough around 1.3440–1.3420 acting as a key support zone.

item.title: Australian Dollar treads water against Japanese Yen ahead of BoJ rate hike
item.description: AUD/JPY trades around 110.55 on Wednesday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.54 per troy ounce, up 1.36% from the $63.67 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: US Dollar: Higher yields and oil support – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that the US Dollar has strengthened modestly as US Treasury yields climb, with the US 10-year yield reaching 5.00% and the 2-year at 4.66%.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Limited losses within 153.30–156.30 band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report USD/JPY has extended its rebound to around 155.08, with modest upward momentum suggesting scope for a test above 155.50, while 156.30 remains a distant cap.

item.title: Eurozone Industrial Production contracts 0.1% in July
item.description: The Eurozone industrial sector activity declines 0.1% in July, according to data published by Eurostat. The industrial output was expected to decline but at a faster pace of 0.2%. In June, the data also contracted by 0.1%, revised lower from 0%.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Fails near 1.3500 as bears eye 200-SMA ahead of Fed decision
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts fresh sellers following an intraday uptick to the 1.3500 neighborhood and drops to the lower end of its daily range during the first half of the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: 1.150 target nears on Fed risk against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole highlights that the Federal Reserve announcement could push EUR/USD towards the 1.150 target.

item.title: WTI falls near $100 as Saudi adds Oman route, US stocks surge
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price depreciates after posting nearly 3% gains in the previous day, trading around $100.00 per barrel during European hours on Wednesday.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Retreats from 155.50 with Fed’s policy in focus
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) turns flat against the US Dollar (USD) at around 155.00 in the European trading session on Wednesday after recovering its early losses.

item.title: Equities: Fed focus and energy shock – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Henry Allen and colleagues note that the S&P 500 has retreated to a six‑week low as higher Oil prices and stagflation fears weigh on risk assets.

item.title: Euro gains against Canadian Dollar as oil prices retreat on rising US crude inventories
item.description: EUR/CAD extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.6090 during European hours on Wednesday. Traders are closely watching the European economic calendar, as the seasonally adjusted Eurozone Industrial Production figures for July are scheduled for release later in the day.

item.title: Oil: Supply risks and central bank pressures – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior Macro Strategist Bas van Geffen highlights escalating Middle East tensions, with Houthi attacks and damage to Saudi infrastructure forcing more Oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Gold traders seem noncommittal below $4,350; eyes Fed rate decision for fresh impetus
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) clings to modest intraday gains through the first half of the European session on Wednesday, albeit it lacks follow-through buying and remains below $4,350. The US Dollar (USD) eases from a two-week high amid some profit-taking, offering support to the commodity.

item.title: Norwegian Krone: Norges Bank weighs inflation and growth – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke highlights uncertainty over whether Norges Bank will hike in September or wait until December. Inflation remains above target despite a recent downside surprise, while growth is described as close to normal.

item.title: Dow Jones futures tick higher ahead of Fed interest rate decision
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain by 0.14% to trade near 52,190 during European hours on Wednesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures rise by 0.21% to trade around 7,600, while Nasdaq 100 futures advance by 0.42% to trade near 29,080.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Bounces off two-month low; seems vulnerable near mid-0.5700s
item.description: The NZD/USD pair bounces off an over two-month low, around the 0.5735 area touched earlier this Wednesday, though it lacks any follow-through buying.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps to near $65 ahead of Fed’s interest rate decision
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 1.8% to near $64.80 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The white metal trades firmly ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Watching break of 0.8205 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann see USD/CHF consolidating just below major resistance at 0.8205 after trading between 0.8164 and 0.8198.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Eyes 1.3950 near ascending channel top
item.description: USD/CAD continues its winning streak for the sixth consecutive day, trading around 1.3930 during European hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates that the price is positioned slightly below the top trendline of an ascending channel, suggesting an ongoing bullish bias.

item.title: US Dollar: Warsh guidance keeps Greenback supported – ING
item.description: ING strategists Francesco Pesole and Frantisek Taborsky note that markets fully expect the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25bp to 4.0%, with a surprise hold seen as materially negative for the Dollar.

item.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) eases from two-week top, holds above 99.50 ahead of Fed
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, retreats slightly from a two-week high, retested earlier this Wednesday, though it lacks follow-through selling.
